title: 航空鈦合金零件加工
summary: 以鈦合金航空零件的虛構加工記錄，分析力、功率、熱差、尺寸與表面缺陷；不指定刀具、轉速、進給或實際加工程序。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use synthetic titanium-component machining records to analyze force, power, thermal mismatch, dimensions and surface defects without specifying tools, speeds, feeds or machining procedures. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 切削力與機械功率：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Cutting force and mechanical power: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 切削力與機械功率 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Cutting force and mechanical power and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 切削力乘切削速度給機械功率；輸入功率還含主軸與傳動損失，熱分配需另量測。
steps.instructionEn: Cutting force times cutting speed gives mechanical power; electrical input includes spindle/drive losses and heat partition needs separate measurement.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空鈦合金零件加工實際性能或製程：切向力F=300 N，速度v=0.5 m/s。式 P=Fv，基準結果 150 W。適用條件：非真機切削參數，只用虛構力與速度比較能量；未含斷續切削。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace titanium-part machining: Tangential force F=300 N and speed v=0.5 m/s. Formula P=Fv gives 150 W. Conditions: Synthetic force/speed energy exercise, not machine settings, excluding interrupted cutting.
steps.failure: 高輸入功率可能來自軸承或傳動，不能全歸於刀具切削。
steps.failureEn: High input power can come from bearings or transmission rather than cutting alone.
steps.check: 同步記錄力、轉速與功率，將無負載主軸功率分開，檢查刀具磨耗趨勢。
steps.checkEn: Synchronize force, speed and power, separate idle spindle power and inspect tool-wear trends.

knowledge.title: 切削力與機械功率
knowledge.text: 切削力乘切削速度給機械功率；輸入功率還含主軸與傳動損失，熱分配需另量測。
knowledge.textEn: Cutting force times cutting speed gives mechanical power; electrical input includes spindle/drive losses and heat partition needs separate measurement.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把F改成360 N；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 150 改為 180 W。在算式區重算並記下對「切削力與機械功率」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only F to 360 N, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 150 to 180 W. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Cutting force and mechanical power, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 哪一項能解釋本單元的工程機制？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement explains this unit’s mechanism?
options: 切削力乘切削速度給機械功率；輸入功率還含主軸與傳動損失，熱分配需另量測。
看到結果符合預期就可省略條件、單位與原始資料。
電表功率等於全部切削熱進入工件。
optionsEn: Cutting force times cutting speed gives mechanical power; electrical input includes spindle/drive losses and heat partition needs separate measurement.
An expected result allows conditions, units and raw data to be omitted.
Metered power equals cutting heat entering the workpiece.
quiz.explanation: 切削力乘切削速度給機械功率；輸入功率還含主軸與傳動損失，熱分配需另量測。 同步記錄力、轉速與功率，將無負載主軸功率分開，檢查刀具磨耗趨勢。
quiz.explanationEn: Cutting force times cutting speed gives mechanical power; electrical input includes spindle/drive losses and heat partition needs separate measurement. Synchronize force, speed and power, separate idle spindle power and inspect tool-wear trends.

steps.title: 工件模具的熱能：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Thermal energy of workpiece and fixture: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 工件模具的熱能 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Thermal energy of workpiece and fixture and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 顯熱以質量、比熱及溫差估算；設備輸入還包括模具熱容量、散熱和反應熱。
steps.instructionEn: Sensible heat uses mass, heat capacity and temperature rise; equipment input additionally covers tooling, losses and reaction heat.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非航空鈦合金零件加工實際性能或製程：m=2 kg，cp=900 J/(kg·K)，ΔT=20 K。式 Q=mcpΔT，基準結果 36 kJ。適用條件：固定比熱且無相變；僅能量帳，不是固化或熱處理設定。 以J算出的能量除1000轉kJ。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace titanium-part machining: m=2 kg, cp=900 J/(kg·K) and delta T=20 K. Formula Q=mcpΔT gives 36 kJ. Conditions: Fixed heat capacity without phase change; an energy balance, not a cure or heat-treatment setting. Divide joules by 1000 for kJ.
steps.failure: 把所有電能都視為試件吸熱會高估升溫。
steps.failureEn: Assigning all electrical energy to the specimen overestimates its temperature rise.
steps.check: 分別列試件、模具及空氣的能量邊界，再比較電能輸入與估計顯熱。
steps.checkEn: List specimen, tooling and air energy boundaries separately and compare electrical input with estimated sensible heat.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非航空鈦合金零件加工實際性能或製程：m=2 kg，cp=900 J/(kg·K)，ΔT=20 K。式 Q=mcpΔT，基準結果 36 kJ。適用條件：固定比熱且無相變；僅能量帳，不是固化或熱處理設定。 以J算出的能量除1000轉kJ。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace titanium-part machining: m=2 kg, cp=900 J/(kg·K) and delta T=20 K. Formula Q=mcpΔT gives 36 kJ. Conditions: Fixed heat capacity without phase change; an energy balance, not a cure or heat-treatment setting. Divide joules by 1000 for kJ.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再僅把m改成3 kg；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 36 改為 54 kJ。在算式區重算並記下對「工件模具的熱能」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only m to 3 kg, holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 36 to 54 kJ. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Thermal energy of workpiece and fixture, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

quiz.question: 依照本單元基準算式，計算結果與單位為何？
quiz.questionEn: What result and unit follow from the baseline expression?
options: 36 kJ
optionsEn: 36 kJ
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非航空鈦合金零件加工實際性能或製程：m=2 kg，cp=900 J/(kg·K)，ΔT=20 K。式 Q=mcpΔT，基準結果 36 kJ。適用條件：固定比熱且無相變；僅能量帳，不是固化或熱處理設定。 以J算出的能量除1000轉kJ。 分別列試件、模具及空氣的能量邊界，再比較電能輸入與估計顯熱。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Aerospace titanium-part machining: m=2 kg, cp=900 J/(kg·K) and delta T=20 K. Formula Q=mcpΔT gives 36 kJ. Conditions: Fixed heat capacity without phase change; an energy balance, not a cure or heat-treatment setting. Divide joules by 1000 for kJ. List specimen, tooling and air energy boundaries separately and compare electrical input with estimated sensible heat.
